name: Announcements
project_description: Announcements provides a fieldable, revisionable, translatable content entity ('announcements_announcement') for showing notices, banners, alerts or promotions to site visitors. Each announcement has a bundle (Announcement Type), a display Style (config entity supplying extra CSS classes), and one or more target Regions (config entities). Announcements are rendered through the 'Announcements Region' block, which is derived per region and shows the published announcements assigned to it. Per-announcement Visibility conditions are supplied by the Condition Field module (the same plugin system core Blocks use), so an announcement can be shown or hidden by page, role, language, and any other condition plugin. Announcement Types can be marked dismissible, in which case a close button is rendered and a per-announcement dismissal cookie is set client-side via the js_cookie library so the notice stays hidden for that visitor. The module ships full entity CRUD with revisions, dynamic per-bundle permissions, and admin UIs under Structure for Types, Styles and Regions.
